purpose: Teach: 釈迦/マイノリティ/駐屯/寒冷/怠惰/連呼/取り締まる/量子力学

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、終末期に釈迦の教えに救われる患者さんの心を医療チームで尊重します
lines.en: Ren — at the end of life, we honor how patients find solace in Buddhist teachings. It's something our medical team takes seriously.
lines.style: Measured, unhurried opening. Clear but not clinical. A moment of quiet respect woven through the words. Steady eye contact, shoulders settled.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療マイノリティの方々の声を医療チームで反映します
lines.en: Yes. We make sure the voices of medical minorities are heard and reflected in our team's work.
lines.style: Direct affirmation. Slight emphasis on 'make sure'—a small commitment. Calm, unperformative. Shoulders stay level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 駐屯地内の医療支援を、貴院、なさってるんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital is providing medical support within the garrison, then, Doctor?
lines.style: Careful, respectful phrasing. Slight upward lilt at the end—checking his understanding, not presuming. Genuinely interested, a little in awe of the scope.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、寒冷地での凍傷治療を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes. We handle frostbite treatment here — managing the specific challenges of cold-injury care as a team.
lines.style: Steady, factual. A quiet pride in the specificity. No flourish. Shoulders open, voice level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 生活習慣の怠惰が引き起こす疾患を、貴院、ご研究中なんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital is researching lifestyle-related diseases — the kind that come from inactivity and poor habits?
lines.style: Thoughtful lilt at the close. Genuinely impressed by the breadth. Leaning slightly forward. Respectful hesitation before 'researching,' as if earning the right to ask.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、連呼するように予防の重要性を医療チームで伝えます
lines.en: Yes. We emphasize prevention constantly — it's something we make sure the entire team understands and communicates to patients.
lines.style: Firm but warm emphasis on 'constantly.' Not aggressive—conviction. A slight lean forward. Clear that this matters to her and her team.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 違法医薬品を取り締まる活動に、貴院、協力されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital is cooperating in efforts to crack down on illegal pharmaceuticals, then?
lines.style: Measured, slightly impressed. The question is carefully framed—not intrusive. Genuine respect for the work. Pause before 'crack down,' letting weight settle.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、量子力学を応用した画像診断を医療チームで導入します
lines.en: Yes. We're implementing quantum-mechanics-based diagnostic imaging — it's a newer tool our team is learning to use effectively.
lines.style: Patient explanation of complexity. No condescension. Clear but not oversimplified. Slight tiredness in the shoulders—not from the work, from explaining it—but voice stays steady and warm.
